resourceName: Gansu Hui County Muge Swine Farm Manure Management System GHG Mitigation Project
description:
Gansu Hui County Muge Swine Farm Manure Management System GHG Mitigation Project (hereinafter referred to as the Project) introduces a new Animal Waste Management System (AWMS) to treat manure from this existing pig farm in Hui County, Longnan City, Gansu Province, which belongs to Xingjiang Muge Co.,Ltd. The purpose of the project activity is to treat the manure and wastewater to avoid methane emissions generated in the baseline uncovered anaerobic lagoons. The estimated lifetime of project is 15 years.
First, all manure and wastewater will be collected and then solids and liquids will be separated. The solid manure will be processed in an aerobic composting system and organic fertilizer will be produced, and the fertilizer produced in this process will be distributed to local farmers free of charge. The liquids will be treated by anaerobic digestion and the biogas produced during the treatment process will be captured and sent to a boiler to generate heat, with the excess gas being destroyed through a combustion system (if available). The sludge produced after fermentation is applied as fertilizer to nearby fields, and the wastewater from the anaerobic digester is used for agricultural irrigation.
With the help of the above-mentioned model, a harmless and ecological use of pig manure can be achieved. It is estimated that approximately 900 tons of animal manure will be handled daily by the AWMS. Also, the generated heat through biogas will be only used for daily operation of the AWMSs and the swine farms themselves and will not be provided to other users. For conservativeness, baseline emissions from heat generation are neglected.
The project activity will reduce of GHG in the atmosphere through avoiding methane emissions from anaerobic treatment of swine manure and wastewater. It is estimated that 68,384 tCO2e emission reductions will be generated annually and total emission reductions are 478,688 tCO2e in the crediting period.
